title: Emit a diagnostic for swallowed daemon recovery cleanup failures
outcome: Unexpected recovery cleanup failures are observable without changing typed results, caller cancellation, shutdown status, or disclosing exception messages and paths.
acceptance: Tests inject unexpected client disposal, stream disposal and in-flight-attempt faults and assert an exception-type-only diagnostic while preserving the original unavailable/uncertain result, cancellation and shutdown status. Diagnostic sink failures must not replace those primary outcomes.
disposal_reason: Continue as independent P3 follow-up after completed shutdown fix w-4a910f482d1c. The review finding is non-blocking and its original review/parent evidence remains in the notes; no implementation has been attempted.
